field.label: Installation key
field.comment: A stable lowercase key (3–64 letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores). Use a different key per Magento installation. Changing it creates new tracking references.

field.label: Public Business ID
field.comment: This public routing identifier is safe to expose in storefront events. Use the business configured for this Magento store.

field.label: API root
field.comment: Use https://api.hellotext.com/v1 for production. Local lvh.me and localhost endpoints are allowed only for development and must not be used by a merchant store.

field.label: Registered customer identity delivery
field.comment: Off by default. When enabled, private Magento customer data lets the Hellotext SDK identify the signed-in customer by their native ID. It does not subscribe customers.
